# costfluent_provider (Data Source)

Fetch a Costfluent provider by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup provider by name
data "costfluent_provider" "aws_main" {
  name = "Production AWS"
}

# Scope a budget to that one connection.
resource "costfluent_budget" "aws_only" {
  name       = "AWS Budget"
  amount     = 10000
  period     = "monthly"
  start_date = "2026-01-01"

  filters = {
    provider_tokens = [data.costfluent_provider.aws_main.id]
  }
}

output "provider_status" {
  value = data.costfluent_provider.aws_main.status
}

output "last_sync" {
  value = data.costfluent_provider.aws_main.last_sync_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Provider token. Either id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) Provider name. Either id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Provider description.
- `key` (String) Provider type key.
- `last_sync_at` (String) Last sync timestamp.
- `last_sync_status` (String) Last sync status.
- `next_sync_at` (String) Next scheduled sync.
- `status` (String) Provider status.
- `sync_frequency_minutes` (Number) Sync frequency in minutes.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
